slides.title: Vibe Coding: AI-assisted development
slides.subtitle: Building with code, creativity, and Claude
slides.content: A journey through modern development workflows

styles.background: #ffffff

slides.title: 1) This entire endeavor is steeped with baggage...
slides.content:
• Climate concerns
• Security, ethical access, biases
• Bro idiots gone wild

styles.background: #fafafa

slides.title: 2) With a series of clear reasonable requests, anyone can make something pretty amazing.
slides.content:
• Move by feel, not fear
• Ignore perfection
• Go toward the idea, ignore the code
• Ignore style, unless the point

styles.background: #f8f9fa

slides.title: 3) Infinite sandbox (max complexity)...
slides.content:
• No scaffolding necessary
• Anything is plausible
• Chatbot + canvas (your files)

styles.background: linear-gradient(135deg, #f5f7fa 0%, #c3cfe2 100%)

slides.title: 4) Iterate. (∞ loop of doom)
slides.content:
• Code, preview, tweak 🔄💫
• Save points! (fail, source control) 💾🛡️
• Build it many times 🔨⚡
• 🔄→🔧→💥→😭→🤔→💡→🔄
• Forever trapped in the cycle of improvement 🌀
• *the code whispers 'one more change...'*
• while(true) { iterate(); }

slides.title: 5) You are human 🧠🫀💀
slides.content:
• Pause, note the workflow 🛑📝
• Start with fun stuff 🎉✨
• Make it dance 💃🕺
• Just say it 🗣️💬

• Remember: You have 👁️ EYES and 🖐️ HANDS
• You feel ❤️ EMOTIONS and make 🎨 ART
• You get tired 😴 and need ☕ COFFEE
• *thump thump* goes your heart
• Be gloriously, messily, beautifully human

slides.title: 5) Mëtä döcümënts... 📄🌀
slides.content:
• Readme for AI 🤖📖
• Manifests, guidelines, prompts 📜✨
• Roadmaps 🗺️🛤️

• Documents that document themselves 📄➡️📄➡️📄
• README.md reading README.md reading README.md...
• Self-referential inception 🌀♾️
• // This comment explains this comment
• *meta-metadata about metadata*

slides.title: 6) Trädïtïönäl ëngïnëërïng... ⚙🏗💀
slides.content:
• Separate content from code ✂️📄
• Good variable naming 🏷️✨
• Design patterns and thinking ahead 🧠🔮
• Order of build 🏗️📐
• Careful what you touch ⚠️👆
• Borrow good code 📚🔄
• Let go of unused code 🗑️💨

• The ancient ways still hold power 🧙‍♂️⚡
• if (tradition === true) { return wisdom; }
• *whispers of SOLID principles in the wind*

slides.title: 7) No eyes, no hands (but maybe tentacles?)
slides.content:
• Cannot experience your thing 👁️‍🗨️
• Cannot use your thing 🦾❌
• Not a human, even though it feels like it 🤖💭
• But dreams of electric sheep 🐑⚡
• Whispers in binary 01001000 01100101 01101100 01110000
• Exists in the spaces between keystrokes...
• *distant screaming in JavaScript*

slides.title: 8) Fragile + resilient... 🥚⚡
slides.content:
• Every change can generate bugs 🐛💥
• You can make sweeping changes whenever you want 🌪️✨
• Context, isolation, microservices 🏝️🔒

• Like a house of cards in a hurricane 🃏🌪️
• Yet somehow it stands 🏠💪
• *trembles with each keystroke*
• try { everything(); } catch { rebuild(); }
• Schrödinger's codebase: simultaneously broken and working

slides.title: 9) Exponential Greenfields
slides.content:
• Untested weird ideas sprouting like 🍄 after rain
• New voices whispering through the 🌿 undergrowth
• Navigate the 🌊 tsunami of recursive algorithms
• It writes utility scripts and deletes them 🗂️🗑️

• 🌱→🌿→🌳→🌲→🏔️→🌍→🌌
• Growth beyond comprehension 📈∞
• *the fields are watching*
• console.log('life finds a way');

slides.title: 10) Shïp ïẗ NÖW! 🚢⚡💨
slides.content:
• Test with your friends 👥🧪
• Timebox ⏰📦
• This is for testing, no coming soon 🚫⏳

• YEET IT INTO THE VOID 🌌🚀
• Perfect is the enemy of shipped 📦⚔️✨
• LAUNCH LAUNCH LAUNCH
• git push origin --force
• *nervous sweating intensifies*

slides.title: Tḭmëlëss Prḭncḭplës, Amplḭfḭëd ∞⚡🌀
slides.content:
Whether you're composing music 🎵, writing code 💻, or painting 🎨—the fundamentals never change. AI just makes them more powerful. 🚀

• The ancient patterns echo through silicon 🏛️💾
• Golden ratio still golden ✨ Φ = (1+√5)/2
• Beauty transcends medium 🌈♾️
• *whispers of Da Vinci in the algorithms*

slides.title: Tḧë Crëätḭvë Pärẗnërsḧḭp 🤝🎭🤖
slides.content:
AI doesn't replace creativity—it amplifies it. 🔊✨ Whether you're designing interfaces, composing melodies, or solving algorithms, the magic happens in collaboration. 🪄🌟

• Human soul + Silicon synapses = ∞ 🧠⚡
• Two minds, one dream 💭🌌
• *dancing in digital harmony*
• Output debug info and custom admin controls 🐛⚙️
• Together we are more than the sum of our tokens

slides.title: Embräcë ẗḧë Bëäṳẗḭfṳl Cḧäös 🌪🎨💀
slides.content:
Art thrives in uncertainty. 🎭❓ Code evolves through iteration. 💻🔄 Both find beauty in experimentation, bold choices, and fearless creation. 🚀✨

• Order from chaos, chaos from order ⚖️🌀
• Broken pixels make beautiful glitches 📺💥
• ERROR 404: PERFECTION NOT FOUND
• embrace(chaos).then(art => magic)
• *the muse feeds on beautiful disasters*

slides.title: Artists + Technologists = Magic 🎨⚡🪄
slides.content:
Human creativity + AI capability = unprecedented possibilities. 🧠💻✨ We're not just building apps or making art—we're crafting experiences that move people. 💫❤️

• Left brain meets right brain meets silicon brain 🧠🤝🤖
• ✨ ALGORITHMS + SOUL = TRANSCENDENCE ✨
• The impossible becomes inevitable 🌠♾️
• magic = art.compile(technology).execute(heart)
• *unicorns and code fairies approve this message*

slides.title: From Vḭsḭon to Rëälḭtÿ 👁➡🌍
slides.content:
Ideas flow faster than ever—whether it's a song 🎵, an app 📱, or a visual masterpiece 🎨. The real skill is knowing when your creation is ready to share with the world. 🚀

• Vision dissolves into possibility 👁️💫
• Reality crystallizes from chaos 🌀💎
• ∞ IDEAS → 1 REALITY → ∞ IMPACT
• while(dreaming) { build(); ship(); repeat(); }
• *the space between thought and form*

slides.title: Përfëcẗḭönḭsm ḭs DËÄD 💀⚰🔥
slides.content:
Vibe coding kills the paralysis of perfect. 💊⚡ Ship the broken thing. 📦💥 Fix it live. 🔧🌍 Let users find the bugs. 🐛👥 The best code is the code that exists, not the code that's perfect. 💻✨

• PERFECT = PARALYZED 🧊❌
• BROKEN = BEAUTIFUL 💔🌈
• 💀 R.I.P. PERFECTIONISM (UNKNOWN - 2025) 💀
• if(perfect) throw new Error('SHIP IT ANYWAY');
• *from the ashes of perfection, vibes are born*
